prompts:
Use case: ui-mockup. Revise the FunBox mini-program proposal according to the user corrections. Output ONE landscape high-resolution review board with TWO large portrait screens side by side, roughly 1500x1400, lots of space for readable Simplified Chinese. Board title 'FunBox / 通用记分 V2', subtitle '01 首页入口与创建房间'. The FIRST reference image is the established Mahjong design board: use its first screen for the existing homepage, its second screen for create-form hierarchy. The second reference image is the actual existing asset atlas: faithfully use its top-left playing cards+coral pawn+blue dice+score tile illustration for the EXISTING homepage hero; its top-middle Mahjong illustration for the existing Mahjong card, bottom-left poker cards+coral chip for existing poker entry. Preserve their shapes and colors. Existing homepage must stay exactly the existing visual identity. This is NOT a homepage redesign. No blue smiley cube brand icon, no new slogan, no substitution of original hero art. Do NOT use prior generic-score V1 homepage. 
Global current code style: canvas #f5f7fa with very subtle top-right blue glow, primary #2d5bff, ink #172139, muted #7b879c, white rounded cards. Blue italic wordmark FunBox, not black. Default PingFang fonts, restrained original layout. Screens without hardware frames, include WeChat status bar and mini-program navigation where appropriate.
LEFT SCREEN: show existing homepage with ONLY one new card appended AFTER the original two. Header blue italic FunBox wordmark, under it small '棋牌记分', right compact white user chip blue circle '游' then '游客' and chevron. Existing hero text EXACTLY two lines '好友相聚，' and '每局都算数。' with '都算数' blue, on the RIGHT original atlas top-left cards/pawn/dice image unchanged. NO white rounded card wrapping the homepage hero. Below EXACT original section title '选择牌局' and inline small note '不同玩法，一样清楚'. Original mint-green rounded horizontal card with LEFT '麻将记分', '4 人牌局 · 给分与结算', green pill '已开放', RIGHT original Mahjong atlas illustration. Original pale peach rounded horizontal card with LEFT '炸金花', '轮流加注，实时看池', coral pill '已开放', RIGHT original poker atlas illustration. Append ONE same-dimension rounded pale blue card below, left title '通用记分', subtitle '灵活人数 · 给分与结算', blue pill '已开放', right a NEW friendly rounded 3D generic blue-bordered WHITE vertical score tile showing BLUE PLUS and CORAL MINUS with small secondary tile behind. Make the new score illustration consistent with existing atlas, but without Mahjong, dice, cards or chips. All cards LEFT text RIGHT art. Existing bottom tabs '首页' active blue and '我的' gray preserved. Allow a slightly taller content viewport so new third card fits without changing original hierarchy.
RIGHT SCREEN: title nav '通用记分'. Use current Mahjong creation page structure faithfully. Top brand text 'FunBox / 棋牌记分', guest pill right. Hero left heading '好友相聚，轻松记分', subtitle '灵活人数 · 给分清楚，结束好结算'; RIGHT replace ONLY mahjong art with NEW generic 3D plus/minus score-tile illustration as on new homepage entry. No oversized full-width hero card. Below keep existing fullwidth rounded segmented bar PALE GRAY, selected LEFT segment '创建房间' solid BLUE with WHITE text, unselected '加入房间' gray. This is existing current code styling. Main WHITE rounded form card. TOP row title '开一局', right compact light badge '灵活人数'. Then standalone prominent inline editable '周末好友局' with pencil immediately next to it: NOT an ordinary labeled fullwidth room-name input. Small helper beneath '名称、密码均可点按修改'. Next label '你的昵称', ordinary bordered rounded fullwidth input '小林'. Next horizontal inline row lock icon, '房间密码', '666666' and pencil: NOT an ordinary labeled fullwidth password input. Thin separator then small gray info icon and EXACT note '先记分，结束时再设置金额'. Fullwidth primary blue '创建房间'. Outside card muted footer '创建后邀请好友，即可开始记分'. Do NOT add participant selector, big people callout, gold note box, extra form sections, feature explanation or redesigned card system.
Bottom annotations outside screens: under left '仅在原入口列表后新增一张卡片'; under right '沿用麻将建房布局，仅替换主题插画与必要文案'. Exact Simplified Chinese, professional clear layout, no watermarks.

Use case: ui-mockup. Revise FunBox generic-score proposal to show the SAME host settlement confirmation workflow as the existing Mahjong mini-program. ONE high-resolution landscape design-review board with TWO large portrait screens side by side, roughly 1500x1400, title 'FunBox / 通用记分 V2', subtitle '02 房主确认金额后结算'. Reference image 1 is EXISTING Mahjong settlement design: follow its FIRST screen (confirmation bottom sheet) and SECOND screen (results) closely; do not copy Mahjong text or 4-player constraint. Reference image 2 actual asset atlas: use bottom-right paper receipt+blue check+plus/minus tile illustration, do NOT add Mahjong tiles, cards, dice, or chips. Original style: background #f5f7fa, white rounded cards, primary blue #2d5bff, navy #172139, muted #7b879c, coral #ff765e, green positive scores. Chinese PingFang, all text accurate. No hardware frames; mini-program nav status bars. This is a concrete revision of original behavior not a new settlement concept.
LEFT SCREEN: nav '通用记分'. Dimmed existing active room behind sheet, visible compact header '周末好友局' '房间 682915 · 6 人' and green sync, faint score-list and give-card layout. Tall bottom sheet white, rounded top corners and gray handle, matching original Mahjong confirmation. Sheet heading '确认结算', helper '请核对每名成员的当前分数与预计金额。' Small subtle role chip '仅房主可操作'. Small original 3D receipt/check/score illustration at right of heading or omit if too dense; do not crowd. MOST IMPORTANT clear editable price FIELD, same place and styling as original Mahjong: label '每分金额', currency prefix '¥', outlined rounded input '0.50', suffix '元/分'. Small helper '房主确认每分金额后再结算'. Do not hide the editable field or replace with static label. Below table header '成员 | 当前分数 | 预计金额'. Six rows:
小林 +48 分 +¥24.00
阿杰 +24 分 +¥12.00
可可 +8 分 +¥4.00
阿安 −12 分 −¥6.00
小雨 −28 分 −¥14.00
阿北 −40 分 −¥20.00
Green positive, coral negative. Show small neutral gray helper below rate '修改金额，预计金额同步更新' if space permits. Coral pale warning '结算后不可修改，请再次确认。' Fullwidth CORAL '确认并结算' button, below pale blue secondary '取消'. Do not show any actual payment buttons. Bottom-sheet contents clear and uncluttered with enough space for all six rows and buttons.
RIGHT SCREEN: nav '通用记分', room header '周末好友局' green small '已结算', meta '房间 682915 · 6 人'. Friendly small original receipt/check/score illustration. Title '本次记分已结束', subtitle '最终积分与转账建议如下'. Compact white card '本局结果', small visible rate text '每分金额 ¥0.50 / 分' (must MATCH the confirmed amount on left). table header '成员 | 分数 | 金额'. Six rows same names and scores and amounts as left:
小林 +48 +¥24.00, 阿杰 +24 +¥12.00, 可可 +8 +¥4.00, 阿安 −12 −¥6.00, 小雨 −28 −¥14.00, 阿北 −40 −¥20.00.
Next white card heading '转账建议', small note '仅为转账建议'. Five compact consistent rows: '阿北 → 小林 ¥20.00', '小雨 → 小林 ¥4.00', '小雨 → 阿杰 ¥10.00', '阿安 → 阿杰 ¥2.00', '阿安 → 可可 ¥4.00'. Footer ordinary button '返回首页'. No new view-history buttons or unrelated workflows.
Bottom annotations OUTSIDE screens: left '房主设置每分金额 → 核对预计金额 → 确认并结算'; right '结果使用房主确认的折算金额'. These are same six-person room and rate across screens. Use rate 0.50 to clearly demonstrate host can modify price rather than automatic default 1.00. No Mahjong terminology or directional seats.
